symbols.name: sequence term
symbols.meaning: The term of a sequence of real numbers at position $\ell$.
symbols.quote: Let $\xi_1, \xi_2, \xi_3, \dots$ be real numbers, where $\xi_\ell$ is the term at position $\ell$, a positive integer.

symbols.name: term position
symbols.meaning: A positive integer giving the position of a term in a sequence.
symbols.quote: Let $\xi_1, \xi_2, \xi_3, \dots$ be real numbers, where $\xi_\ell$ is the term at position $\ell$, a positive integer.

symbols.name: tail start
symbols.meaning: The position from which a tail of a sequence begins.
symbols.quote: For a position $\mu$, the tail from $\mu$ is the set of terms $\xi_\ell$ with $\ell \ge \mu$.

symbols.name: tail infimum
symbols.meaning: The greatest lower bound of the terms of the tail from position $\mu$.
symbols.quote: Its infimum $\eta_\mu$ is the greatest lower bound of these terms: the largest real number that is at most every term of the tail, or $-\infty$ if no such number exists.

symbols.name: real tolerance
symbols.meaning: A positive real number used as the distance below which terms are counted.
symbols.quote: Then $\liminf_{\ell\to\infty} \xi_\ell = 0$ if and only if, for every real tolerance $\varepsilon > 0$, infinitely many $\ell$ satisfy $\xi_\ell < \varepsilon$.

symbols.name: time ratio
symbols.meaning: The running time of machine $A$ on inputs of length $n$, divided by $n\lg n$.

symbols.name: threshold
symbols.meaning: The input length from which the conjectured lower bound holds for machine $A$.
symbols.quote: That is, $T_A(n) \ge c_A\, n\lg n$ whenever $n \ge N_A$, where $N_A$ is the threshold from which the bound holds.

relations.quote: The limit inferior is applied against [Schönhage–Strassen multiplication](schonhage-strassen.md), since $\rho_n$ measures a running time against the $n\lg n$ order that the authors of that method conjectured to be optimal.
The limit inferior takes its values in the [extended real numbers](extended-reals.md), because a nondecreasing sequence there has a limit, its supremum.
